bulletin.title: KCMC Community Updates — October 18–24, 2026
bulletin.welcome: Same God. New Mercies. Every Day. Worship, serve and share time together at KCMC. There is a place for you here!
notes: Sunday, October 18 — Worship at 8:00, 9:15 and 10:30 AM; LaunchKids Children’s Church at 10:30 AM.
Sunday, October 18, 10:20 AM — Friends of Faith Sunday Bible Study, Pairs & Spares Classroom. Becoming Like Jesus by Matt Chandler.
Thursday, October 22, 1:30 PM — Way Forward All Church Informational Meeting with Pastor Tony.
Return filled Pregnancy Life Line baby bottles by Sunday, October 25.
Saturday, October 31, 4:30–6:30 PM — Trunk or Treat in the church parking lot. Sign up your trunk this Sunday; individually wrapped candy donations are needed at the office or in the lobby.
Saturday, November 14, 4:30 PM — Richard French Memorial Lasagna Dinner, Fellowship Hall. Tickets are $15 each.
For prayer or a conversation with a pastor, call the church office at 417-739-4395. Services are live-streamed on Facebook.

trunk-or-treat-2026.description: Bring the family for a bounce house, hot dogs, hot cider and a costume contest. Sign up your trunk this Sunday, decorate your vehicle and help distribute candy. Individually wrapped candy donations may be dropped off at the church office or in the lobby. All are welcome.

pll-bottle-return-20261025.description: Please return your filled baby bottle by Sunday, October 25. Fill it with change or folding money to support Pregnancy Life Line/Southern Missouri. Contact the church office with questions.

pll-bottles-20261025.body: Fill your baby bottle with change or folding money to support Pregnancy Life Line/Southern Missouri. Please return your filled bottle by Sunday, October 25. Small Change Makes a Big Impact! Contact the church office with questions.

trunk-volunteers-20261014.body: Help us reach at least 30 decorated trunks! Sign up to bring your vehicle and welcome children and families. The pastors have promised a party for participants if we reach 30 trunks. Volunteers should arrive by 3:30 PM on October 31 to park and decorate. Plan for approximately 200 children: about 200 individually wrapped treats for one each, or 400 for two each. Use commercially packaged, individually wrapped treats. Extra candy is available, and the church can provide candy if purchasing it is a burden. Drop off donated candy at the church office or in the lobby. Keep decorations and optional costumes family-friendly and not frightening; an adult volunteer costume contest is planned. Keep walkways clear and cords secure. Keep vehicles parked until the event is over and families have cleared the area. Smile, welcome each child and be patient with shy visitors. Contact the church office with questions. The October 16 Front Pew News asks trunk participants to sign up this Sunday. The public event runs October 31, 4:30–6:30 PM in the church parking lot, with a bounce house, hot dogs, hot cider and a costume contest.
